# Real-ESRGAN-x8

Super Resolution · `realesrgan-x8_192x192` · DX-APP C++ example

Super Resolution model, evaluated on BSD100.

**Input** 192 × 192 × 3 · **Dataset** BSD100 · **License** BSD-3-Clause · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![Real-ESRGAN-x8 output](../../../../python_example/super_resolution/realesrgan/realesrgan-x8_192x192/result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/super_resolution/realesrgan/realesrgan-x8_192x192/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models RealESRGAN_x8-1
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target realesrgan-x8_192x192_sync   # once
./bin/realesrgan-x8_192x192_sync \
  -m assets/models/realesrgan-x8_192x192.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_lowres165x90.png
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/super_resolution/realesrgan/realesrgan-x8_192x192/realesrgan-x8_192x192_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/realesrgan-x8_192x192.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_lowres165x90.png
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | PSNR | SSIM |
|---|---:|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 19.98 | 0.57 |
| Q-Lite | 19.97 (−0.01) | 0.55 (−0.02) |
| Q-Pro | 7.10 (−12.88) | 0.08 (−0.49) |

BSD100 · difference vs Raw in brackets.

> **Note:** Q-Pro is 12.88 points below Raw on PSNR.
